decisions.statement: A name is matched against the ESOUI title or against an install folder.
A name matching nothing on ESOUI is refused as bad input.
An entry naming no install folder is refused rather than guessed at.
An entry installing a folder the deploy owns is refused.
Forcing is consent to install a third-party addon again.
Forcing is no consent to drop an archive over a folder the deploy owns.
An addon whose every folder is already there is skipped unless forced.
An archive with no folder the caller expected is refused.

definition: one addon named by hand, looked up on ESOUI and laid into the addons directory
